text:
alex: Quick check — can we lock in a short async+live handoff today for the cross-timezone watches? APAC overlap is small so want a tight agenda.

maria: I'm +1 for 20m at 17:30 PT. Prefer async notes first, then a 10m live to confirm escalations.

sam: Works for me. I can run the first 5m incident roundup.

jin: I can take escalation liaison for billing incidents today. Leaving at 18:00 PT though.

oncall-bot: INCIDENTS: 2 active (INC-4423 database 503 spikes, INC-4471 cache evictions). Pager duty: @sam on primary, @maria on secondary.

alex: Agenda proposal: 1) quick incident states (owner + status) 2) who is on escalation watch for each 3) any outstanding runbooks missing owners 4) roll-forward / followups. Keep it 15-20m.

maria: +1. Add a quick sanity check for Dedicated pool autoscale alerts (they've been flapping).

sam: I'll ping infra to confirm autoscale thresholds before meeting.

jin: For runbooks — INC-4423 has partial steps but missing rollback notes. I can draft rollback steps after the meeting.

alex: OK — async notes: please paste a one-line status for your items in this thread before 17:15 PT so I can compile. Live bridge 17:30 PT -> https://meet.redwood.com/hand-off-17-30 (10m pin + 10m overflow).

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: Oncall Handoff standup in 15m (link above).

maria: Status: INC-4423 — DB 503 spikes, mitigation: traffic reroute applied by infra, error rate down 40%, owner @sam. Need follow-up to validate query patterns tomorrow.

sam: Status: INC-4471 — cache evictions correlated with mem pressure on pool 3, temporary mem bump applied, owner @sam, mitigation ongoing.

jin: Status: Dedicated autoscale — alerts flapping due to noisy metrics; infra asked to add 10s smoothing window. Owner @jin for follow-up.

alex: Nice — I combined the notes. For the live: we'll confirm escalation contact for each incident and assign action items. If no objections, I'll start bridge at 17:30 PT. :thumbsup:

maria: No objections. I'll be there.

sam: On it.

alex: Post-meeting plan: I'll drop a tiny doc in #eng-oncall with decisions + owners and set reminders for follow-ups. If anyone can't make the live, paste your one-liners here (we'll treat as async attendance).

jin: One-liner acknowledged.

ops-bot: NOTE: runbook INC-4423 flagged incomplete (missing rollback). Please add owner tag or open RFC.

alex: Got it — @jin will draft rollback steps, @maria will validate autoscale smoothing with infra, @sam continues mitigation. Thanks all — see you on the bridge.
